Real Estate Commission

  1. Home
  2. Real Estate Commission

Welcome to the Real Estate Commission

As of October 30, 2026, DOPL has begun transitioning the Real Estate Commission to biennial licensure. Click the link to Board News to determine how and when your fees and renewal cycle will be impacted, and to review other helpful FAQs.

As of January 1st, 2026, DOPL began implementing a Fee Holiday for the Real Estate Commission. Click the link to Board News to determine how your fees will be impacted, and to review other helpful FAQs.

Video Tutorials for DOPL’s Online Services.  Click HERE to log into your account!

For questions, please email BCRE-Licensing@dopl.idaho.gov or call (208) 334-3233.
